conventions.premium: coin premium multiplied by contemporaneous index_price
conventions.selection: 4 expiries nearest 14/35/75/150 days within 10-190 days; <=11 OTM strikes near log-moneyness targets -0.25 to 0.25

limitations: A bounded, sequential quote snapshot, not historical option data.
Top-of-book quotes indicate available sides at capture; fills, market impact and historical hedge performance are not observed.
USD equivalents use contemporaneous indices and zero-discount forward pricing; the hedge experiment does not replicate coin collateral.
Book timestamps establish snapshot freshness, not the last modification time of each standing order.
metadata.title: Options Volatility & Dynamic Hedging
metadata.data_classification: Observed Deribit option snapshots; hypothetical model prices and simulated hedge paths.
metadata.holdout_convention: Every fourth strike within each expiry withheld. Cross-sectional interpolation check, not a future-date forecasting test.

diagnostics.identifiability_note: Three deterministic starts and bid/ask perturbations; one snapshot does not establish stable or unique structural parameters.

BTC.risk_conventions: Hypothetical USD call F=K=100, T=30/365. Spot shock is relative. Vol shift changes sqrt(v0) and sqrt(theta); skew shifts rho. Greeks are Heston forward delta/gamma and vega per absolute change in sqrt(v0), theta held fixed. All results are precomputed.

assumptions.status: Hypothetical simulated experiment; not historical or live trading performance.
assumptions.contract: Short one European USD cash-settled call; F0=K=100, 30/365 years; zero drift and zero funding.
assumptions.position: Short call, long model delta. Same initial Heston premium for every strategy and stress.
assumptions.costs: Proportional absolute dollar turnover; 5 bp base and stress, 20 bp high-cost; includes initial hedge and terminal liquidation.

policies.every_step: Rebalance after every simulated state observation.
policies.every_6_steps: Rebalance at steps divisible by 6; actual interval changes with step count.
policies.delta_band: Rebalance when absolute target-minus-held delta reaches 0.05.

scenarios.high_cost: Exactly the base paths and targets, four times transaction-cost rate.
scenarios.volatility_stress: Initial variance and long-run variance multiplied by 2.25; same normal shocks. Heston hedge retains baseline structural parameters and observes current variance.
scenarios.spot_jump: Deterministic unpriced 12% downward spot jump at midpoint; same diffusion shocks and variance as base. Not a fitted jump process.

assumptions.simulation: Log-Euler spot; full-truncation Euler latent variance. Negative variance proposals counted and positive part used in drift/diffusion. No path deletion, delta clipping, or P&L winsorization.
assumptions.numerical_deltas: Heston deltas must agree on successive quadrature grids within 0.0002 and lie within [−0.00001, 1.00001]. Small numerical bound excursions are retained, not clipped. Unresolved states abort the experiment.
assumptions.hedge_information: Targets use only current spot, observed current variance and time; no future path information. Variance is perfectly observed in this hypothetical experiment.
assumptions.attribution: Common conditional-Black reference with volatility sqrt(current variance), not Heston Greeks. Interval-start delta/gamma/theta/variance Taylor terms, exact repricing residual, and initial premium gap reconcile to net P&L after costs.
assumptions.attribution_floor_note: Explicit diagnostic-only variance floor avoids the singular zero-variance Greek; does not affect paths, trading deltas, or accounting. Floor activations and the full residual are retained.
assumptions.intervals: 95% normal-approximation Monte Carlo intervals estimate mean uncertainty only; quantiles are sample estimates. Pairwise intervals use common-path differences.
assumptions.limitations: No bid/ask dynamics, financing spreads, margin, liquidity, slippage beyond proportional cost, execution delay, stochastic rates, or coin collateral. Path count and Euler resolution limit precision.
